name: How long do hardware adjustments typically take?
description: Time varies based on complexity; a single hinge takes minutes, while a kitchen full of cabinets takes hours.

mainEntity.name: How long do hardware adjustments typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for hardware adjustments depends on the complexity and number of items needing attention. Simple tasks like adjusting a single door hinge might take a few minutes, while a comprehensive adjustment of all cabinet hardware in a kitchen could take a few hours. A professional can provide a time estimate based on the scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Time varies based on complexity; a single hinge takes minutes, while a kitchen full of cabinets takes hours.
